strategy_and_methodology.risk_strategy: Continuous risk lifecycle covering identification, quantitative modeling, response execution, and audit.
strategy_and_methodology.tools_and_repositories: Central PMO risk register repository and automated risk radar notification boards.

roles_and_funding.roles_and_responsibilities: Risk Manager facilitates workshops, Risk Owners execute mitigation strategies and contingency actions.
roles_and_funding.contingency_funding: Management reserves capped at 10% of total project baseline, allocated upon Steering Committee signoff.

probability_and_impact_definitions.probability_scale: Five-point scoring scale from 1 (Very Low <10%) to 5 (Very High >70%).
probability_and_impact_definitions.impact_definitions: Calibrated matrix assessing cost variance (>10%), schedule slippage (>2 weeks), and quality impact.

scoring_and_matrix.matrix_grid: Standard 5x5 probability-impact matrix resulting in low, medium, and high severity tiers.
scoring_and_matrix.thresholds_and_triggers: Risks with score >= 15 require mandatory escalation to Executive Sponsor within 24 hours.

categories_and_cadence.breakdown_categories: Technical, External, Organizational, Commercial, and Project Management risk categories.
categories_and_cadence.audits_and_cadence: Bi-weekly sprint risk reviews and formal monthly independent risk governance audits.
